newsitem.title: CROATIA: Quake hits Croatia's Adriatic coast, no damage.
newsitem.headline: Quake hits Croatia's Adriatic coast, no damage.

text.p: A moderate earthquake shook Croatia's southern Adriatic coast on Friday, months after a series of strong quakes and aftershocks caused serious damage to the area, the Croatian Seismological centre said.
The quake measuring 4.1 on the Richter scale struck the Ston-Slano area near the historic city of Dubrovnik at 11.25 am (1025 GMT), seismologist Ivica Sovic told Reuters.
An official at the Dubrovnik alert centre said no damage had been reported so far.
The Ston-Slano area suffered 6.0 and 5.5 quakes in September and had to be partly evacuated after the tremors due to landslides and damaged houses.
The September quakes undid much of the work done in the area to repair severe damage suffered in the Croatian-Serb war of 1991.
